      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not kernel work; does not alter libbitcoinkernel interfaces or boundary logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "P2P label, extensive changes across net.cpp and net_processing.cpp to isolate transaction relay and connection management into dedicated Tor/BIP324 jobs.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.8,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "The rewrite addresses severe deanonymization risks in master's private broadcast implementation. As reviewers noted, coupling broadcast connections to shared node state represents an 'active footgun that worsens privacy once adversaries adapt', making origin privacy protection a category-critical issue."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/rpc/mempool.cpp only hook the private broadcast subsystem into transaction submission rather than changing the RPC interface.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not RPC; exposing private broadcast behavior via RPC calls belongs to the P2P area rather than RPC infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds functional tests and fuzzers in src/test/fuzz/privbcast_attempt.cpp dedicated specifically to validating private broadcast logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test files pin the behavior of the private broadcast subsystem rather than modifying general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/init.cpp handle initialization of the private broadcast subsystem.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Init changes only serve the private broadcast feature's startup lifecycle rather than general utility primitives."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches transaction primitive definitions without modifying validation rules or chainstate logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not validation; bypasses local mempool validation and does not change consensus or chainstate rules."
    }
